_comment: Example MCP client configuration (format used by many MCP clients, e.g. Claude Desktop / Kiro / Q CLI). Carried over from the original Strands workshop to illustrate local MCP servers in notebook 07. CampusMate itself uses AgentCore Gateway as a managed, remote MCP server instead.

campusmate-gateway._comment: Connect any MCP client to YOUR CampusMate gateway through a local SigV4 proxy (AWS_IAM inbound auth). Replace the URL with config.get_resource('gateway_url').
